storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content:
She calculated the speed of her sword, the angle to avoid attacks.

She calculated the feasibility of escape plans and the probability of the world moving toward the future.

Until the very end, she never stopped calculating.

Just as she never stopped walking this desolate path.

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
■ File Number: AF315-C01
■ Awakener Codename: @2 Walker
This Awakener was first observed in A.F. 315, @1.

During the initial "Artificial Domain" experiment, influenced by the psychic resonance of the homogenous object, the "Artificial Domain" based on the Spirit Realm of our university's @2-level student Ramona Dexter unexpectedly broke through dimensional boundaries.

At that time, the Keeper confirmed the existence of the world outside dimensions for the first time in that "Artificial Domain" and also confirmed how @2's power would affect Ramona Dexter.

Thereafter, researches on the "Genesis Awakeners" was officially launched by the Awakener Sciences Research Institute.

Meanwhile, the planning of the teaching plan for new Power Control course for Ramona Dexter is also on the agenda.

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
"Ramona" shows great restraint in appearing. As she mentioned, she only manifests in this world when called by the Keeper.

She always comes and goes swiftly, seemingly not wanting to engage further with our world beyond battle.

Is it fear of the nightmares that plague her? Or fear of longing for the things she has lost... We cannot know.

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
She had an enviable birth: an orphan raised as the sole heir—how fortunate.

She had remarkable wisdom: speaking at one, debating at two, beginning her enlightenment at three.

She had admirable talent: a photographic memory and mastery of the sword. At an incredibly young age, she passed Mythag University's rigorous preparatory courses with full marks.

She had companions she could rely on, with whom she could venture into darkness and the unknown.

<Italic:She had...>

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
When occupying Ramona's body, "Ramona" has never walked through the campus.

Lotan's boldness, Ogier's shy loyalty, William's calm composure, Doll's strict seriousness... No one remembers these moments more than she does.

But she always kept in mind: these beautiful things no longer belong to her.

Now, she needs to focus entirely on protecting another destined person... This is also to protect another precarious world and another innocent version of herself.

daily.title: Awaken
daily.content: If you can still see me as "Ramona"... then please continue to use that name.

daily.title: Upgrade: I
daily.content: Please don't worry.

daily.title: Upgrade: II
daily.content: In the end, I'm only...

daily.title: Upgrade: III
daily.content: ...straying further from my former self.

daily.title: Enlighten: Observe
daily.content: It's drawing closer...

daily.title: Enlighten: Ponder
daily.content: Something is wailing... inside my mind.

daily.title: Enlighten: Reflect
daily.content: It feels like a veil of white mist is clouding my thoughts.

daily.title: Enlighten: Insight
daily.content: The sound is louder now. The mist thickens.

daily.title: Enlighten: Elevate
daily.content: Is that the sound... of the clock's hands turning?

daily.title: Enlighten: Florish
daily.content: When the final bell tolls... will I still be here?

daily.title: Affinity: I
daily.content: The eye patch doesn't affect my sight. If anything, it helps me avoid seeing too much.

daily.title: Affinity: II
daily.content: Too many mysteries, too many people who need saving. I don't know how long I can keep this up... I cannot protect everyone. It is difficult.

daily.title: Affinity: III
daily.content: Do I look... unfamiliar? I've been trying to keep control. Her presence is growing stronger.

daily.title: Affinity: IV
daily.content: I don't regret becoming this, Keeper; I'd choose it again. But I am afraid... afraid that the "Ramona" I used to be will leave no trace behind.

daily.title: Affinity: V
daily.content: Make a promise with me? Promise that, no matter what happens, you'll remember "Ramona".

daily.title: Chat: Touch
daily.content: Curious about what's under the eyepatch? I'll show you... when the setting is more appropriate. Do not be impatient.

daily.title: Chat: About Tawil
daily.content: Tawil... she is far more dangerous than we realize. When I'm no longer here, you must be extremely cautious of her.

daily.title: Chat: About @2
daily.content: Have you encountered the other Doll? The so-called "truth of the world" can shatter a calm mind completely. Will we... will you and I become the same?

daily.title: Chat: About Murphy
daily.content: Compared to the noble ladies at that party, Murphy's temper is rather endearing.

daily.title: Chat: About Dissolution
daily.content: I've seen past events of the Dissolution in her memories... But every time I try to speak of it, my consciousness breaks. I believe it's her doing.

daily.title: Chat: About Mythag
daily.content: Mythag holds the most memories for me... it is also my warmest home.

daily.title: Chat: What I Like
daily.content: Time spent with friends is always so... relaxing.

daily.title: Chat: What I Hate
daily.content: Ramona... I mean, I don't like farewells. They are too sad.

daily.title: Chat: About the Keeper
daily.content: As long as I am still "Ramona"... we are still partners, aren't we?

battle.title: Investigation Halted
battle.content: Not enough... I'm still not strong enough.

battle.title: Exalt
battle.content: Heaven and Earth, follow the cycle of causality!

battle.title: Over-Exalt
battle.content: I will be the one to reveal the future!
